response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 as region, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM `order` o JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) as overall_avg FROM order_counts), with_differences AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.region, oc.order_count, oc.order_count - os.overall_avg as difference, AVG(oc.order_count - os.overall_avg) OVER (PARTITION BY oc.region) as region_avg_difference FROM order_counts oc CROSS JOIN overall_stats os) SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference, difference - region_avg_difference as exceeds_region_avg FROM with_differences WHERE difference > region_avg_difference ORDER BY exceeds_region_avg DESC LIMIT 10
